cards.en: give us full measure and be charitable to us
he recognized them, but he was to them unknown
the best of stories

cards.title: From the Well to the Throne
cards.sub: The Complete Story of Hazrat Yusuf (AS)

cards.en: O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me
O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan
And thus will your Lord choose you
Do not kill Joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well
I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware
You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive
And they brought upon his shirt false blood
so patience is most fitting. And Allah is the one sought for help
they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams
And Allah is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know
She closed the doors
[I seek] the refuge of Allah
But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful
and cut their hands
My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me
O [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or Allah, the One, the Prevailing
Mention me before your master
Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry

cards.text: 7 years of plenty · 7 years of hardship · then rain

cards.en: Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful
Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian
We do not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

chapters.title: The Brothers and the Golden Cup

cards.en: But Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful
Indeed, I am your brother, so do not despair over what they used to do
so patience is most fitting. Perhaps Allah will bring them to me all together
I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know
despair not of relief from Allah
Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant
I am Joseph, and this is my brother
No blame will there be upon you today. Allah will forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful
Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing
Did I not tell you that I know from Allah that which you do not know
O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality
There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding
